channel.title: Christopher Liles · Senior Tier 3 Product Solutions Engineer
channel.description: Practical systems, clean networks, and a homelab that earns its rack space.

item.title: A Quiet DNS and Telemetry Stack for the Lab
item.description: AdGuard Home in front of Unbound, plus Prometheus and Grafana, for DNS that is predictable and metrics that actually get used.

item.title: Proxmox VE and ZFS: Cluster Notes from a Two-Node Lab
item.description: How a two-node Proxmox cluster can use local ZFS for guests, a TrueNAS backend for shared data, and replication that is honest about what two nodes can and cannot provide.

item.title: Segmenting a Homelab with OPNsense and VLANs
item.description: A practical VLAN plan for a small lab: management, compute, storage, and services, with OPNsense interface, DHCP, and firewall rule patterns that stay easy to audit.
